title: Design: the Delete question and the deleted message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses with no customers that priced nothing.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Delete.
  4. Click Delete in the dialog.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Audit Log, Archive and a red Delete.

Step 3:

  • A dialog titled "Delete" tier A's name "?" reads "Parts already on work orders keep their prices." with Cancel (white) and Delete (red).

Step 4:

  • A message at the bottom right reads tier A's name "deleted", as in picture 2.30.
  • Tier A is gone from the list.
